newsitem.title: USA: Roberds says settles shareholder suit.
newsitem.headline: Roberds says settles shareholder suit.

text.p: Home furnishings retailer Roberds Inc on Tuesday said it and its insurers will pay $1.6 million to settle a shareholder suit against the company and certain of its officers.

Roberds said it will pay $342,500 of the settlement and the insurance carrier for its officers and directors will pay $1,257,500. In settling the case, neither Roberds nor its officers have admitted any wrongdoing or improper action. The lawsuit was originally filed early in 1994 in Federal District Court in Dayton.
The settlement is subject to approval by the court.
